criteria.requirement: Add Config.validate(constraints) explicit lightweight nonmutating validation returning aggregated {path:[keys],code} diagnostics for required/type/nullable/choices/minimum/maximum/properties. Missing and None differ; reject bool as int/float unless bool explicitly allowed, preserve literal dotted keys and recurse only through explicit properties. Existing loading/dict semantics remain unchanged and values are never converted or included in diagnostics. Correct configurations pass unchanged; invalid rule fields/types raise configuration errors rather than guessing a schema or leaking values. Do not broaden this into HTTP request validation.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
